name: Riverside Distribution Depot
description: A small overnight freight depot: a loading dock, a supply room, a locked storeroom, and an alley out back.

loading_dock.name: Loading Dock
loading_dock.description: Pallet jacks and empty crates line a concrete loading dock. A supply room door stands north, and a service alley runs east.

supply_room.name: Supply Room
supply_room.description: Metal shelving holds crates of everyday stock. A hand-lettered sign reads 'ask before you take.' A storeroom door east has a cylinder lock on it, and the register sits where Dana can watch it.

storeroom.name: Storeroom
storeroom.description: Locked stock, stacked to the ceiling and inventoried twice a week. A wire cage on wheels is chained to the wall beside the door.

back_alley.name: Back Alley
back_alley.description: A narrow service alley behind the depot, lit by a single flickering lamp. Crates are stacked against the wall, and the far end of the alley turns out of sight.

alley_end.name: End of the Alley
alley_end.description: The alley dead-ends at a fire door nobody uses. Otis keeps a folding chair here, a battery lantern, and no particular interest in where things came from.

holding_room.name: Holding Room
holding_room.description: A bare supply closet repurposed as a holding room: a bolted door, a folding chair, and nothing else.
